newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper up but other base metals steady.
newsitem.headline: India copper up but other base metals steady.

text.p: Copper prices climbed up but other base metals were steady in limited activity on the local market, dealers said on Wednesday.

Copper rose by 25 rupees to 13,875 rupees on the reports of price hike announced by state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL). HCL has hiked copper prices by 1,000 rupees to 5,000 rupees per tonne for July. Hindustan Zinc Ltd. too hiked zinc prices by 2,500 rupees per tonne for July but in the open market zinc prices were steady at 8,150 rupees per quintal.
"Marketmen expected HZL to hike prices since a week and this factor was already discounted for market," one broker said.

Tin and nickel found fresh support today at the lower level after recent losses. Tin was steady at 29,800 rupees and nickel at 34,500 rupees per quintal. Lead was quiet at 4,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
